profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Accomplished Full Stack Software Engineer, with a proven track record of designing, developing, deploying and maintaining desktop applications for the oilfield services industry. Adept at tackling complex technical challenges, with a focus on performance optimization and enhancing user experience. Known for meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code supported by thorough documentation for long-term sustainability. Highly skilled in debugging and troubleshooting to ensure robust and reliable software solutions.

positions.title: Snr Software Engineer CTRM
positions.description:
Working on Pilot's internal Fuel Profit Platform I maintain and develop two web based applications.
One written using Java and Angular, the other Node.js and React.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Angular · React · .NET · Node.js · Spring Framework · Confluence · Jira · SQL · Jenkins · Amazon Redshift · pgAdmin · Microsoft Visual Studio Code · Visual Studio · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS CloudFormation · Git · GitHub

positions.title: Desktop Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained and developed the Integrated Asset Modeler (IAM) desktop application, used by internal and external clients for oil field development planning scenarios. IAM integrated multiple upstream and downstream simulators through custom adapters, delivering comprehensive modeling capabilities.

positions.title: Software Architect Petrotechnical Integration
positions.description: Integrated the Peep Economics engine into the Petrel desktop application within the Value & Risk group. Commercialized the Merak Enterprise Planning (MEP) application, including creating developer documentation, build environments, distributed test environments, performance testing, and profiling.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Led a team of 5 developers in the New Interactive Simulation Environment (NISE) project, establishing a foundation for new applications. Created coding standards, a multi-language build environment and designed and implemented the core code library.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Rapidly revamped the FloGrid Application to enhance the Graphical User Interface (GUI) to meet evolving user expectations and increased product adoption.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Spearheaded development and maintenance of a cross-platform GUI framework in C++, built around two third-party C libraries (XVT and XI) using the MVC design pattern. Wrote platform-specific code to enhance functionality. This framework was used by all internal desktop applications to implement their GUI

positions.title: Software Support Engineer
positions.description: Worked in the Installations Group providing on-site software installation, configuration, and development services across Europe. Responsibilities included tailoring solutions to meet client needs, often requiring innovative problem-solving.

positions.title: Student Engineer
positions.description: Worked in the Graphics Group to enhance product quality by developing test suites for in-house GKS graphics software using C and FORTRAN.
